scripts.check: npm run check:repo && npm run check:python && npm run check:web
scripts.check:python: npm run check:python:format && npm run check:python:lint && npm run check:python:types && npm run check:python:test
scripts.check:python:format: uv run --locked ruff format --check apps/api/src packages/data_models/src packages/workflows/src tests scripts
scripts.check:python:lint: uv run --locked ruff check apps/api/src packages/data_models/src packages/workflows/src tests scripts
scripts.check:python:types: uv run --locked mypy apps/api/src packages/data_models/src packages/workflows/src scripts
scripts.check:python:test: uv run --locked pytest tests/unit tests/workflow tests/integration --cov=agent_ip_api --cov=agent_ip_data_models --cov=agent_ip_workflows --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=100
scripts.format: uv run ruff format apps/api/src packages/data_models/src packages/workflows/src tests scripts && uv run ruff check --fix apps/api/src packages/data_models/src packages/workflows/src tests scripts && npm run format --workspace @agent-ip/web
